cover_letter:
Dear JIMBER team,

I'm writing to apply for the AI-Powered B2B Marketer for Cybersecurity Growth role. Your description of shaping market strategy, sharpening the story and turning it into visibility, interest and qualified sales opportunities is the kind of work I want to do. I bring a technical background and a focus on where SEO, content and web meet, with AI and code used to automate the repetitive parts.

In my current work at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I manage CMS content in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and keep existing content current. On the freelance side, I designed, built and run baverok.com myself, including a hand-coded landing page with structured data and accessible markup. For mirook.com I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO and GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. That mix of structured data, entity optimization and AI search visibility is directly relevant to making a cybersecurity company findable and credible.

I also hold HubSpot Content Marketing and Google Analytics GA4 certifications, and I use LLMs daily for research, content and audits, including MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools. I'm comfortable coordinating with external creatives and equipping sales with clear presentations and content, and I track performance in analytics tools to see what actually works.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help JIMBER sharpen its story, manage its website, LinkedIn, email marketing, SEO and events, and scale the campaigns that bring qualified opportunities.

Kind regards,
